# Bound (LLMs.txt)
#
# Purpose: Provide concise product context for LLMs and agents.

## Product summary
Bound helps teams fine-tune speech models from just a few hours of audio while keeping full ownership of their model and data.

## What Bound does
- Ingests a few hours of audio plus a chosen base model
- Cleans and prepares audio automatically
- Manages GPU training, evaluations, and parameter tuning
- Supports deployment on customer infrastructure or via Bound for low latency

## How it works (homepage)
1. Upload your audio and choose a base model
2. We clean and prepare your data
3. We handle the training and optimization
4. Deploy on your terms

## Positioning
- Simple, end-to-end fine-tuning pipeline for speech models
- Focus on ownership of data and model weights
- Designed for production-ready voice models
